title: NedoOS kernel NeoGS SD driver installer (ngssd.bin)
note: ngsinst.asm at #5B00: patches the stock COMTAB[#1E] to GSDDRV at #1D00 and returns to COMINT_; the kernel sends 768 bytes, the match covers the 686 of the blob

commands.name: SD driver (GSDDRV)
commands.note: sub-command 0 init, 1 compare, 2 read, 3 write (TABLSDG); a read / write moves the count of 512-byte sectors (0: 256), each after a #BB strobe; one status byte after all: #77 done, #88 no card (compare), #99 card lost, #EE card not found (init)
